fact: The NSDS III, 2024-2028 (June 2024) states that the NSDS II, 2017-2021, was evaluated and the evaluation presented at the 2nd bi-annual meeting of the National Consultative Committee on Statistics in 2023, and that a mid-term review is due in 2026.
title: Third National Strategy for the Development of Statistics in Nigeria, 2024-2028
